title: When the Debt Breaks
author: Juniper Okonkwo
blurb: Edmund Kavanagh, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
